CustomField.description: Apex class implementing FlowFaultLogSink that persists faults. Use Namespace.ClassName for a namespaced class. Default: FlowFaultNebulaLogSink (requires the nebula-adapter package directory). If the class cannot be resolved the handler falls back to FlowFaultDebugLogSink and reports isLogged = false with the reason.
CustomField.label: Log Sink Class
